proposed_comments.title: Remove every legacy H1 without consuming body content
proposed_comments.body:
### Remove every legacy H1 without consuming body content

**Severity:** `medium`

The matcher only accepts the literal `# ` form, so valid tabbed/bare ATX and Setext H1s can remain and duplicate the GitHub release title. Its trailing `\s*` also spans line breaks and indentation after the heading, while the replacement always writes LF, which can alter a CRLF body or the first indented block. Match only the heading and blank-only separators, recognize both heading forms, and preserve the original newline.

```suggestion
    $newline = if ($block.Contains("`r`n")) { "`r`n" } else { "`n" }
    $heading = [regex]::new(
        '\A' + [regex]::Escape($beginMarker) + '\r?\n(?:[ \t]*\r?\n)*' +
            '(?: {0,3}#(?:[ \t]+[^\r\n]*|(?=\r?\n|$))(?:\r?\n|$)|' +
            ' {0,3}\S[^\r\n]*\r?\n {0,3}=+[ \t]*(?:\r?\n|$))'
    )
    return $heading.Replace($block, "$beginMarker$newline", 1)
```

confidence.rationale: The pinned upstream matcher uses broad \s* around a literal #-space heading and hardcodes LF; the exact replacement parsed and preserved CRLF and body indentation in targeted tests.

proposed_comments.title: Reject Setext H1s during release verification
proposed_comments.body:
### Reject Setext H1s during release verification

**Severity:** `medium`

This guard only recognizes ATX `#` headings, so a Setext H1 (`Release title` followed by `===`) passes verification despite the documented no-H1 rule. Add the Setext form with CRLF-safe matching so final verification rejects a body that still duplicates the GitHub release title.

```suggestion
if ($managedBody -match '(?m)^ {0,3}#(?:[ \t]+|\r?$)|^ {0,3}\S[^\r\n]*\r?\n {0,3}=+[ \t]*\r?$') {
```

confidence.rationale: The exact pinned verifier checks only an ATX prefix; a Setext H1 demonstrably bypasses the current regular expression and is covered by the literal replacement test.

proposed_comments.title: Reject Setext H1s before draft creation
proposed_comments.body:
### Reject Setext H1s before draft creation

**Severity:** `medium`

This pre-creation guard also recognizes only ATX headings, so a Setext H1 (`Release title` followed by `===`) can pass the draft checks and ship a duplicated top-level heading. Add the same Setext pattern used by verification so invalid notes are rejected before creating the draft.

```suggestion
if ($content -match '(?m)^ {0,3}#(?:[ \t]+|\r?$)|^ {0,3}\S[^\r\n]*\r?\n {0,3}=+[ \t]*\r?$') {
```

confidence.rationale: The exact pinned draft-creation check is ATX-only; the current check accepts Setext H1 input, while the proposed CRLF-safe expression rejects it.
